entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-09-25
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • Unknown switch ucr, use-current-runtime not working for restore, build and publish #37567
  • [AI discovered CI] dotnet.Tests.dll.2 repeatedly times out in Linux Helix work item #55916
  • CA1517 false positive when span elements are mutated via `foreach (ref var ...)` #56292
  • dotnet sln remove now throws NullReferenceException on bad paths #54763
  • Add support for root assembly trimming mode #27492
  • Backport descriptive MTP exit-code summaries to .NET 10 and .NET 11 #56104
  • [aw] Failed jobs: Build Failure Analysis #56224

Updated

  • Microsoft.DotNet.Cli.New.IntegrationTests.CommonTemplatesTests.FeaturesSupport: intermittent hang (test host hang-dump timeout, exit code 7) #55551
  • Test flakiness for Microsoft.NET.Sdk.StaticWebAssets.Tests.StaticWebAssetsIntegrationTest.Build_DoesNotUpdateManifest_WhenHasNotChanged #55516
  • Template Engine SSL Connection Issue #51574
  • Workload Feature Band Test Sometimes Fails #45314
  • Failure on Helix tests - Tests timing out #40074
  • dotnet-watch tests failing #40006
  • Main branch net12.0 transition status tracking #55851
  • Add an agent workflow to identify potentially stale `[Ignore]` attributes #56121

PullRequests

Created

  • Share the Azure Monitor telemetry storage directory between managed and AOT CLI #56409
    Servicing-consider
  • Accept `dotnet run -p` as a short form of `--project` #56408
  • Move `dotnetup` back to Azure's OTel After Requested Fixes #56407
  • Validate workload --source feeds before acquiring manifests #56406
  • Add an agent workflow to identify potentially stale references in Ignore attributes, TODOs, and workarounds #56405
  • Update common project templates to net12.0 #56404
  • Add net12 workload manifest authoring #56403
  • Measure CLI activities and MSBuild submission durations #56402

Merged

  • [release/11.0.1xx-rc2] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56382
    11.0-rc2
  • Suppress default values for .NET CLI flag options #55928
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56400
  • [DoNotParallelize] Narrow GivenAPickBestRidMultiThreading serialization to the CWD-mutating test #56398
    Test Debt
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56381
  • [release/11.0.2xx] Prevent CA2263 from changing generic System.Type values #56343
    Servicing-approved, backport
  • Fix CA1517 for mutable span enumeration #56393
  • Fix NullReferenceException in `dotnet sln remove` for .slnx files with invalid path #55125
  • Retry connection resets in Build Failure Analysis setup #56396

Updated

  • Add `dotnetup self update` command #55511
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56399
  • Plumb CancellationToken through all CLI commands for consistent Ctrl+C/SIGTERM behavior #56332
  • Add Microsoft-internal classification to CLI telemetry #56388
    Area-Telemetry
  • Add shared CLI string resource runtime #56387
  • Fixed syntax issues and colliding rules in default .editorconfig #56328
  • Port runtime PR dotnet/runtime#133111 R2R changes to SDK Crossgen tasks #56395
    Area-ReadyToRun, Area-WasmSdk, 12.0-preview1
  • File-based apps: allow metadata on `#:include` #56392
    Area-run-file
  • Harden agentic workflow detection runs #56397
  • Fix `applicable_kinds` for type parameters in EditorConfig template #52899
